Through pre-emptive service incident and resolution activities, this role will restore service to clients by driving incidents to an effective resolution and ensuring all requests, process events and resolution incidents result in zero missed service level agreement (SLA) conditions. Identifies and resolves problems following agreed procedures. Carries out agreed maintenance tasks. Ensures usage of knowledge articles in incident diagnosis and resolution and assist with updating as and when required. Performs defined tasks to monitor service delivery against service level agreements and maintains records of relevant information. Provides service recovery, following resolution of incidents. Documents and closes resolved incidents according to agreed procedures. Maintains secure, accurate, complete, and current configuration on configuration items (CIs). Ability to adapt to changing circumstances. Entry level knowledge of vendor technologies, such as (but not limited to) Cisco, Juniper, Aruba, RiverBed etc. Entry level knowledge on management agent concepts, redundancy concepts and remote console architecture within supported technical domain. review_candidates.description: Company Description At GJR Technologies, we specialize in IT consulting, delivering comprehensive solutions tailored to diverse business needs. Our experienced professionals provide strategic advice and implementation support across software, hardware, SAP integration, and general IT services. We focus on optimizing IT infrastructure and enabling digital transformation for organizations of various sizes and industries. Beyond technical delivery, we align IT strategies with broader business objectives to create sustainable, long-term value. More information about our services and approach is available at www.gjrgroup.eu. Role Description The Information Technology Support Engineer is a full-time, Onsite role based in Puch bei Hallein, Austria . In this position, the engineer will provide day-to-day technical support to internal users and clients, including resolving hardware, software, and network issues. Responsibilities include managing help desk requests, diagnosing and troubleshooting incidents, performing routine system administration tasks, and ensuring timely resolution of support tickets. The role also involves maintaining documentation, monitoring system performance, assisting with IT infrastructure upgrades, and collaborating with other IT specialists to implement best practices and improve service quality. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong skills in Technical Support and Help Desk Support for end users and client environments. Candidates should possess solid knowledge of Information Technology fundamentals, including hardware, software, and networking concepts. Candidates should possess advanced Troubleshooting abilities for diagnosing and resolving technical issues efficiently. Candidates should possess System Administration skills, such as user management, configuration, and basic server or cloud environment support. Relevant qualifications include prior experience in an IT support or help desk role, preferably in a consulting or service-oriented environment. Additional beneficial qualifications include familiarity with SAP-related environments, ITIL or similar service frameworks, and common ticketing systems. Strong communication skills, customer-focused mindset, and the ability to work collaboratively in a hybrid team setting are essential. A relevant technical degree, professional certification (e.g., CompTIA, Microsoft, Cisco), or equivalent practical experience is highly valued.
